t: The Franke Ascona mono mixer kitchen tap is a durable and stylish fixture for modern kitchens. Constructed from chrome-plated brass, this sink-mounted tap features double lever 1/4 turn operation and ceramic disc valves for reliable control and longevity. Its surface-mounted design with a swivel spout offers practical functionality, while the built-in aerator ensures a smooth, consistent water flow. Suitable for high-pressure systems, this kitchen tap provides a professional finish, ideal for new installations and renovation projects.
